description: This file defines the MessageException class, a custom exception class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, used for handling message-related exceptions. It declares constructors, a destructor, and a method to retrieve the exception message.

classes.name: MessageException
classes.description: A custom exception class derived from std::exception, used to represent message-related errors within the framework.

methods.name: MessageException(const string& message, bool inclSysMsg = false)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message and optional system message inclusion flag.

methods.name: Message()
methods.description: Returns the exception message as a TCHAR string.
